steps.npc: If you don't stop talking to me, I'll never squeeze in my slouching time for the day.
I'm old and fat if that's what you're driving at. What, are you thinking of trading me in for a younger model?
After all the adventuring we've done together? Is that it?

steps.player: No, nothing of the sort. I was just making conversation, that's all.

steps.npc: Sure, I know your game. Going to trade me in for some death runes are you? Eh?

steps.player: What? How do you know about that?

options.text: Where do you want to go?

steps.player: Where do you want to go?

steps.npc: I'd just like to go somewhere nice and warm.

options.text: What do you want to do now?

steps.player: What do you want to do now?

steps.npc: I want to have a snooze, all this talking has made me sleepy.

steps.player: Gosh, you're a bit dull and boring.

steps.npc: I suppose that's what you become once you pass your 10th birthday.

steps.player: Hey there fatty! Fancy a tummy rub?

steps.prompt: Are you sure you want to shoo away the cat?

steps.player: I've had enough of you and your whining, all you do is mope around all day. Just go away and don't come back.

steps.npc: I'm getting tired of your company anyway! You must be the most boring adventurer ever. You couldn't find your way to Lumbridge without me.

steps.text: You choose not to shoo away the cat.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-chasing-.player: Are you up for some rodent catching?

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-chasing-.npc: If you mean by rodent catching, getting myself killed by attacking that there rat,.... no.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-chasing-.player: Oh go on, I'm sure you'd take it.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-chasing-.text: The cat is just too big to catch vermin.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-with-a-c.npc: Sorry human, but what are you wearing?

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-with-a-c.player: I got some cat ears made for me, don't they look meeeeeeeooooowvalous.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-with-a-c.text: The cat looks you dead in the eye, unblinking.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-with-a-c.npc: Am I a joke to you?

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-with-a-c.player: I thought it'd be cute and funny.

standard-dialogue-with-catspeak-with-a-c.npc: It's not, take them off now human, before I get myself a pair of human ears to wear.

placing-into-the-pet-basket.text: The cat goes to sleep on the blanket.
